name: contract_m7_tables
description: The M7 contract (docs/design/contract-m7.md) holds: undertow follows tide_race as mode 3, its wire id, one seat on each of two teams; the Drift's packs are the four checks with the hollow's creeps and counts per tier (Gourdlings 6, 14, 20; Scuttlers 8, 17, 28; Thornbacks 3, 5, 9; Duskmoths 4, 5, 7), each pack's own premium and spacing keyed by a check; the duel's events are 21 to 27 and its refusals and commands the numbers M1 reserved; SimUndertow.commit, once written, hashes the contract's bytes; and the undertow preset, once added, has a shared clock and every duel key, the client's auto uncork before the fizzle.

steps.msg: the code keeps the M7 contract
